Date January 16. 1939.

Subject "Woo Shing Association" - Branch office established

Made by D.S.I. Liao Chung-chien Forwarded by C. Garside D.S.

x Lee D936
(4-12-39) re
dissolution of

Further to Special Branch report dated December 20,
1938, the "Woo Shing Association" ( 和 兴 公 會 ) with
head office at 5th floor, Arnhold Building, 320 Szechuen
Road, has established a branch office at Lane 37, No.119
Brenan Road.

On January 15, a leaflet purporting to have
emanated from the "Woo Shing Association" was obtained
by the Municipal Police. According to this leaflet,
the Association was renamed the "Woo Shing Association"
from the "Shanghai Economic Construction Society," a
Japanese sponsored organization located at Lane 37,
No.119 Brenan Road, and this Association is to hold
itself responsible for the acceleration of "economic
cooperation" between the Chinese and Japanese on a more
extensive scale than that conducted by the "Shanghai
Economic Construction Society."

Attached is the copy of the leaflet together
with translation.

E

继1938年12月20日的特科报告之后，“和兴公会”（和興公會）总部设于四川路320号阿诺尔德大楼5楼，已在北安路119弄37号设立分部。

1月15日，公共租界警务处获得一份据称出自“和兴公会”的传单。根据该传单，该协会由位于北安路119弄37号的日本赞助组织“上海经济建设社”更名为“和兴公会”，该协会将负责在比“上海经济建设社”所开展的更广泛范围内，加速中日之间的“经济合作”。

随函附上该传单副本及译文。

TRANSLATION

Object of the "Woo Shing Association"
.......

(I) Title : "Woo Shing Association."

This Association is formed to extend the
activities of the former "Shanghai Economic
Construction Society." Apart from re-constructing
the Chinese economic structure, and eradicating
corrupt practices, this Association will devise
ways and means to meet the desire of the people to
enjoy a peaceful life. The "Woo Shing Association"
is renamed from the former Society with a view to
building a powerful economic structure in Central
China.

(II) Object : This Association has the object of
joining the people of the two nations together
through economical relations. China and Japan
are neighbouring countries with only a narrow
sea as their natural boundary. However, the
difference in racial customs has given rise to
misunderstandings from time to time, and on the
lines of economic construc-tion, this Association
will endeavour to bring the true sense of the
Japanese spirit to those people so that they can
help each other in effecting mutual prosperity.
Every assistance will be rendered the people, for
instance, in obtaining passes, permits, etc.

(III) Enterprises :

(1) Should the Chinese merchants, after the formation
of their trade unions or other new bodies, intend to
become members of this Association, a plan to

“和兴公会”之宗旨

(一) 名称：“和兴公会”。

本会旨在扩展前“上海经济建设社”之活动。除重建中国经济结构、铲除腐败积弊外，本会将 devised 方式方法，以满足民众享受和平生活之愿望。“和兴公会”由前社更名而来，意在华中地区建立强大的经济结构。

(二) 宗旨：本会旨在通过经济关系将两国人民联结在一起。中国与日本乃邻邦，仅以一衣带水为天然界限。然而，种族习俗之差异不时引起误解，本着经济建设之方针，本会将致力向民众传达日本精神之真义，以便双方互助，实现共同繁荣。凡民众所需之协助，例如获取通行证、许可证等，均将予以提供。

(三) 事业：

(1) 若中国商人在组成其同业公会或其他新团体后，有意加入本会，则将实施一项计划，

Subject Woo Shing Association (和興公會).

Made by                 Forwarded by

A "Woo Shing Association" has recently come into existence
with an office established in a room on the 5th floor, Arnhold
Building, 320 Szechuen Road. From enquiries it has been
ascertained that this Association was formed by one Hu Tse
Ming (胡子明), an ex-Inspector of the Japan-China Cotton
Mills, at the instigation of Ling Tse Chung (林志炯), a
Formosan. It has for its object the organization of different
trade associations in Shanghai and effective control over them.
The chief promoter, Hu Tse Ming, at present resides at
No.24, Lane 37, Brenan Road, O.O.L., and is employed with the
Western Branch of the Police Bureau as a detective. He con-
currently serves as a leader of an armed gang which affords
protection to the Fu Sung Gambling Den, 10 Ting Nyieh Li,
Brenan Road, and an opium den situated in House No.6 of the
same alleyway.
Ling Tse Chung, who is behind the formation of the above
association, is also the leading figure behind the organization
of the following bodies:-

Society.                            Road, east of the Jessfield

近期成立了一个“和兴公会”，办事处设在四川路320号阿诺尔德大楼5楼的一个房间内。经查询获悉，该协会由前日华纱厂稽查胡子明 (Hu Tse Ming) 在台湾人林志炯 (Ling Tse Chung) 的唆使下组建。其目的是组织上海各同业公会并对其进行有效控制。
主要发起人胡子明目前居住在北安路37弄24号（越界筑路区），受雇于警察局西区分局担任侦探。他同时兼任一个武装帮派的头目，该帮派为位于北安路定业里10号的福生赌窟以及同弄6号的鸦片馆提供保护。

Eastern Times :- 12-12-38 (PM)

JAPANESE FORMING CHINESE GENERAL LABOUR UNION

After the fall of Shanghai, a certain
party was very active in the formation of a Chamber of
Commerce and a General Labour Union in an attempt to
induce various trade associations and labour unions to
co-operate with it, but all such attempts have been
fruitless.

Recently, a man named Hu Min-tsu (胡明治)
and others organized a Ho Shing Guild (和兴公会) to
facilitate the transportation of merchandise and to promote
business. Local trade associations are ignoring the
existence of this guild.
As regards the labour union, a "Chinese Workers
Welfare Association" (中華工人福利会) has been formed by one
Hu Shou-chong (胡寿昌) with a Korean named Lin Ts-chuan
(林賀炯) as Chief Secretary and a Japanese named Kubo as
director.

E 1/2

《申报》:- 1938年12月12日 (下午)

日本人组建中国总工会

上海沦陷后，某派系在组建商会和总工会方面非常活跃，试图诱使各同业公会和工会与其合作，但所有此类尝试均无果而终。

最近，一名叫胡明治 (Hu Min-tsu) 的人等人组织了“和兴公会” (Ho Shing Guild)，以便利货物运输和促进商业。本地同业公会无视该公会的存在。
至于工会，一个“中华工人福利会” (中華工人福利会) 已由胡寿昌 (Hu Shou-chong) 组建，由一名叫林贺炯 (Lin Ts-chuan) 的朝鲜人担任总秘书，由一名叫 Kubo 的日本人担任董事。

E 1/2
